answer.summary: The Docker build fails in the front-end stage because yarn build (Vite/rolldown) hits a JSX syntax error in openaev-front/src/admin/components/graph/Graph.tsx, a file this PR changes: an unclosed 'Box' tag at line 290 plus an unexpected token at line 292. This is a deterministic compile error from the change, so a rerun on the same commit will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: #39 2.043 [builtin:vite-transform] Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for 'Box'.
#39 2.043 [builtin:vite-transform] Unexpected token. Did you mean `{'}'}` or `}`?
#39 ERROR: process "/bin/sh -c yarn build" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
